name: Washington County, TN
findings: Washington County has 391 nonprofit organizations. 178 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 144 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Washington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
